description: Three clock dividers that keep their phase together, with the first clock after a reset split off as a separate downbeat

params.text: Sets that divider's ratio, a whole number from 1 to 16
Sets which step of that divider's count the output falls on, 0 to 100 per cent of the ratio

inputs.text: Advances all three dividers on each rising edge above 2V, and sets how many polyphonic channels the divided outputs carry
Holds the count at zero while it reads above 2V and marks the next clock as the downbeat; every channel of a cable here is summed first, so any channel high resets

outputs.text: 10V for the first clock pulse after a reset and 0V for every clock pulse after that
10V for every clock pulse except the first one after a reset
10V while the clock is high and the count has reached that divider's step, and 0V the rest of the time
10V while an odd number of the three divided outputs are high, and 0V otherwise

notes: the divided outputs follow the clock's own high time: they are the clock gated by the division rather than pulses of a length the module sets
nothing comes out of the divided outputs until a clock is patched to CLK; the outputs take their channel count from that cable and carry none without it
on a polyphonic clock each channel hands its pattern on to the next channel on that channel's own rising edge, so the channels run as a shift register down the cable

inputs.0:
high above 2V · stepped · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.1:
high above 2V · stepped · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
